title: Generative Modeling via Drifting
abstract: arXiv:2602.04770v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Generative modeling can be formulated as learning a mapping f such that its pushforward distribution matches the data distribution. The pushforward behavior can be carried out iteratively at inference time, e.g., in diffusion/flow-based models. In this paper, we propose Drifting Models, a new generative modeling paradigm that evolves the pushforward distribution during training and naturally admits one-step inference. We introduce a drifting field that governs the sample movement and achieves equilibrium when the distributions match. This leads to a training objective that allows the neural network optimizer to evolve the distribution. In experiments, our one-step generator achieves state-of-the-art one-step results on ImageNet 256x256, with FID 1.54 in latent space and 1.61 in pixel space. We hope that our work opens up new opportunities for high-quality one-step generation.

translated_abstract: 生成建模可以被表述为学习一个映射 f，使其前推分布与数据分布相匹配。前推行为可以在推理阶段迭代执行，例如在扩散模型或流模型中。在本文中，我们提出了漂移模型，这是一种新的生成建模范式，它在训练过程中演化前推分布，并自然地支持一步推理。我们引入了一个漂移场来控制样本的移动，并在分布匹配时达到平衡状态。由此得到一个训练目标，使得神经网络优化器能够演化分布。在实验中，我们的一步生成器在 ImageNet 256×256 上取得了一步生成领域最先进的结果，在潜空间中的 FID 为 1.54，在像素空间中的 FID 为 1.61。我们希望这项工作能为高质量的一步生成开辟新的机遇。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为“漂移模型”的新生成建模范式，通过漂移场在训练过程中演化前推分布并实现一步推理，在 ImageNet 256×256 上取得了一步生成最先进的性能（潜空间 FID 1.54，像素空间 FID 1.61）。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Drifting Models, a new generative modeling paradigm that evolves the pushforward distribution during training via a drifting field to naturally enable one-step inference, achieving state-of-the-art one-step generation results on ImageNet 256x256 with FID 1.54 in latent space and 1.61 in pixel space.
